output_list.criticism: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The initialSupply is added to the balanceOf[target] without a check, causing a potential overflow if initialSupply is very large.
The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The balanceOf[msg.sender] -= _value is executed before the overflow check, causing a potential overflow if _value is very large.
The transferFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The balanceOf[_to] += _value is executed before the overflow check, causing a potential overflow if _value is very large.
The burn function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The balanceOf[msg.sender] -= amount is executed before the overflow check, causing a potential overflow if amount is very large.
